skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Direct DMG 30% ATK to the target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Applies [Mark] and [Counter] to all enemies, then deals Direct DMG 20% ATK per [Mark] (minimum 3) to all enemies. 30% chance to [Faint] the target's column for 2 rounds while [Round] < 6.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Applies [Mark] and [Counter] to all enemies, then deals Direct DMG 20% > 30% ATK per [Mark] (minimum 3) to all enemies. 30% chance to [Faint] the target's column > entire selected area for 2 > 6 rounds while [Round] < 6.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gain +20% HP. On entry and on revive, himself and surrounding allies become immune to [Corrode] and [Specialized Corrode] for 5 rounds.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Immunity to [Corrode]/[Specialized Corrode] duration 5 rounds > Permanent.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Immunity scope himself and surrounding allies > all allies.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of the battle, grants 45% chance of [Evade] (Reduce Direct/Extra/Charge/Berserk DMG to 1 DMG). Removes [Combo Follow-up] from the whole enemy team, lasts the whole battle.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc:
Evade 45% > 60% Additional effect: After any character acts, for every enemy in [Specialized Stun], increases [Specialized Protection] of all allies by 100% Metal Knight ATK, 3 times per round.
[Specialized Stun] is not affected by SSR+ Metal Bat, SSR+ Gouketsu and SSR+ Melzargard [Combo] from SSR+ Deep Sea King and [Ultimate Follow-up] from Cruel Tactic can inflict [Specialized Stun]

effects.desc: PvP shields reduce or negate damage to allies.
PvP tier of Stun — harder to resist or resolve.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Mark a unit, unlocking a raid condition or bonus effect associated with the mark.
One turn in a match; Many effects are limited to the current number of turns (e.g. only effective when Round < 6).
The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
A counter mark whose class number gradually increases the user's direct counter damage to marked enemies.
The enhanced Corrosion over Time damage variant has the ability to retarget itself, to which some units may be immune.
Continuous corrosive damage over time gradually erodes Health, which can be blocked by zone immunity.
